name: cable guide for custom partial finger replacement

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, tapered plate designed as a hand-back guide for a finger prosthetic. The main body is a trapezoidal plate, wider at one end and narrower at the other, with three deep, U-shaped cutouts along the wider edge to accommodate finger webbing. It features three small, circular mounting holes aligned horizontally across the center of the plate. Along both the wide and narrow outer edges, small cylindrical loop guides are raised to act as cable routing channels.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric back-of-hand cable guide for a partial finger prosthetic. The model should feature a flat, tapered trapezoidal base plate controlled by a knuckle width parameter, with three deep webbing slots cut into the wide edge, three central screw holes, and small cylindrical cable guide loops aligned along the top and bottom edges.
captions.factory: The script constructs the base plate by performing a linear extrusion of a 2D polygon defined with coordinates relative to the knuckle width parameter 'kw'. Webbing spaces are subtracted from the wide edge using scaled cylinders, and three mounting holes are subtracted using simple cylinders. The knuckle and wrist guides are created by adding small, hollowed-out cylinders rotated 90 degrees along the X-axis, positioned at specific offsets on both the top and bottom edges of the plate.
